planets.name: LTT 9779 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of LTT 9779 with a 0.792-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: LTT 9779 b was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around LTT 9779. Its orbit and size follow Jenkins et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname JENKINS_ET_AL_2020): disc_year 2020, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 0.7920645022, pl_radj 0.4210902, pl_bmassj 0.09225057

quotes.title: LTT 9779 b
quotes.card: LTT 9779 b, officially named Cuancoá, is a Neptune-sized planet orbiting the sunlike star LTT 9779, or Uúba.
quotes.introduction: As of 2023, it has the highest-known albedo of any planet.
